title: TerminalColors - folder configuration
description: .terminalcolors.json file: associates a colour with a folder and, by default, with all of its subfolders.

$schema.description: URL of this schema (optional, for editor autocompletion).

color.description: Project colour: hex code (#RRGGBB), known colour name (Teal, SteelBlue, ...) or "auto" to derive a stable colour from the project name.

name.description: Label shown in the tab. Defaults to the folder name.

icon.description: Symbol shown before the label. Defaults to a coloured square derived from the colour.

tint.description: Terminal background tint strength for this project. Overrides the global setting (0.30 by default). Ignored in pure-colour mode.

branches.description: Per-Git-branch colours. The key accepts wildcards (release/*). The first match wins.

applyToSubfolders.description: When false, the colour applies to this folder only, not to its subfolders.
